title: RenderGraph node needs source-local GLM experimental opt-in
body: Fresh queued WSL build of the affected RenderGraph target failed at VIXEN/libraries/RenderGraph/src/Nodes/AccumulationConfigNode.cpp:19 because GLM 1.0.1 rejects gtx/norm.hpp without GLM_ENABLE_EXPERIMENTAL. I had to add the canonical source-local define, matching SVOBuilder.cpp:8, before the include so the RenderGraph test target could compile. Suggested consolidation: derive or centralize the GLM extension opt-in in the target or project portability policy, so a lane does not patch an unrelated node to witness another module. Tier haiku: one obvious include-policy fix; effort:S.
